# Scenario: proxy.target.service-name may match the YAML compose service key;
# nginx reaches <service_key>.apinfra_<project> on apinfra_proxy_net.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: YAML service key as proxy target'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-api

exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'api\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: api
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  api:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- .env --
